title: Vulnerability Exception Record Compiler
description: Compiles a formal vulnerability exception record. Enforces: expiry within 90 days, mitigation context is meaningful (not boilerplate), an approver is declared.

error_codes.VE001: vuln-exception-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: cveId, severity, expiresAt, mitigation, approver
error_codes.VE002: Exception expiry exceeds 90 days from today — vulnerability exceptions must be short-lived and reviewed regularly
error_codes.VE003: Mitigation context is too short or generic — explain specifically why this vulnerability is acceptable in this context
error_codes.VE004: No approver declared — vulnerability exceptions require a named security approver
error_codes.VE006: No affected components listed — declare affectedComponents[] to precisely scope which packages or services carry this exception
